test_name: Verify Product Search and Navigation to Product Details Page
description: Validates the ability of users to search for a product by category and navigate to its details page.
steps: Click on the 'ACCESSORIES' menu link in the navigation bar.
Wait for the Accessories category page to load.
Locate and click on the product link 'Light Brown Purse'.
Wait for the product details page for 'Light Brown Purse' to fully load.
Verify that the product name 'Light Brown Purse' is displayed on the product details page.
Verify that the product description and pricing information are displayed.
expected_results: User is successfully redirected to the Accessories category page.
User is successfully redirected to the product details page of 'Light Brown Purse'.
Product name, description, and pricing information are correctly displayed.
edge_cases: Product link is missing or broken.
Category page fails to load due to server issues.
Product details page fails to load or displays incorrect information.
Navigation link for 'ACCESSORIES' is disabled or non-functional.
Network latency causes delayed page loading.
data_requirements: Category page must have products listed.
Product 'Light Brown Purse' must exist in the Accessories category.
Product details page must have valid data (name, description, price).
Category and product data must be pre-populated in the database.
dependencies: The Accessories category must exist and be accessible.
The product 'Light Brown Purse' must be listed under Accessories.
The navigation menu must be correctly implemented.
performance_metrics: Page load time for Accessories category page.
Page load time for product details page.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure that navigation links have appropriate ARIA roles.
Verify that the product details page is fully keyboard-navigable.
Check for proper alt text for images on the Accessories category page.
